steps.en: Install the package with its React peers
steps.zh: 装上这个包和它要求的 React

steps.en: Render the Excalidraw component in a container with a real height; import its CSS
steps.zh: 在有实际高度的容器里渲染 Excalidraw 组件，并引入它的 CSS

steps.en: Runs the whole editor on a canvas: tools, arrow binding, undo, libraries, hand-drawn rendering
steps.zh: 在画布上跑起整个编辑器：工具、箭头吸附、撤销、素材库、手绘风渲染

steps.en: Reports every edit as plain JSON elements plus app state
steps.zh: 每次编辑都以纯 JSON 元素加应用状态回报给你

steps.en: Store that JSON in your backend and hand it back when the page reopens
steps.zh: 把这份 JSON 存进你的后端，页面重开时再交还给它

value.en: A whiteboard inside your own product whose data is JSON you own, without building a canvas editor
value.zh: 你的产品里多了一块白板，数据是你自己掌握的 JSON，不用自己写画布编辑器

sources: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/README.md (npm install react react-dom @excalidraw/excalidraw; import "@excalidraw/excalidraw/index.css"; container with non-zero height)
https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/dev-docs/docs/@excalidraw/excalidraw/api/props/props.mdx (onChange receives elements and app state; initialData)
https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw#features (tools, arrow binding, undo/redo, shape libraries, i18n, export)
